scenes.say: Tired eyes after work? Your screen brightness might be the problem.

scenes.en: Your eyes keep adjusting when the screen and room don't match
scenes.ta: திரைக்கும் அறைக்கும் வெளிச்ச வித்தியாசம் கண்ணைச் சோர்வாக்கும்
scenes.say: Here's why. When your screen is much brighter or darker than the room, your eyes keep adjusting, and that adds to the strain.

scenes.en: Like a sheet of paper in that light, not a lamp
scenes.say: Step one. Match the screen to the room. It should look like a sheet of white paper in that light, not like a lamp. Don't work in a dark room.

scenes.en: Keep windows to the side, not behind or in front of the screen
scenes.say: Step two. Beat the glare. Place the screen so windows are to the side, not behind it or behind you. Tilt it slightly to remove reflections.

scenes.en: Dark text on a light background, and bigger text
scenes.ta: வெள்ளை பின்னணியில் கருப்பு எழுத்து, பெரிய எழுத்து
scenes.say: Step three. Use dark text on a light background, and make the text bigger, so you don't lean in.

scenes.en: Eye doctors say screen light doesn't damage eyes. Strain comes from staring and blinking less.
scenes.ta: திரை ஒளி கண்ணைச் சேதப்படுத்தாது; சோர்வு மட்டுமே
scenes.say: Did you know? The American Academy of Ophthalmology says there's no evidence that screen light damages the eyes. The strain comes from long staring and blinking less.

scenes.en: Headaches or blur after screen time? Book an eye test.
scenes.say: If you still get headaches or blurry vision after screen work, you may need glasses. Book an eye test.
